captures.description: 'The Studio for Patacinematics is a conceptual framework and specialized institutional space operating within the generative, avant-garde architecture of the Crimson Hexagon Archive and the Johannes Sigil Institute of Comparative Poetics.' 'It is rooted in speculative theory, experimental media, and speculative pataphysical design rather than traditional filmmaking.' Disclaimer: 'the studio exists in an abstract, digital, and theoretical domain rather than as a physical studio space.' Concepts: Impossible Screenings, Recursive Fabrication. Zenodo 'THE STUDIO FOR PATACINEMATICS — INSTITUTIONAL CHARTER' first organic ('1 day ago').
